meta.description: Retroactive pilot record from completed compaction ablation (6 rounds, 40-task subset, 2 arms)

design.subset: compaction_subset_40.txt (40 long-trajectory tasks, median 153 tool calls, 6 categories, seed=42)
design.order: ABBA: basic_r1 -> agentic_r1 -> agentic_r2 -> basic_r2 -> basic_r3 -> agentic_r3
design.compaction_trigger_note: cline 3.0.51 trigger is strategy-dependent: basic ~230K tokens, agentic ~120K tokens. models.json contextWindow=32000 is IGNORED. Plan v2's 32K tight-context regime not implementable on 3.0.51.

results.subgroup_category_best: Simulation & Analysis Configuration (delta=+20.0pp, n=5, only category where agentic helps)

conclusions.Q1_agentic_3pp_gain: No. -10pp stable decline every round. McNemar delta=-12.5pp, CI[-25,0].
conclusions.Q2_long_session_only: No gain anywhere. Negative effect larger on long trajectories (delta=-15pp vs -10pp short).
conclusions.Q3_default_recommendation: basic. Higher Pass@1 (+10pp), fewer gen_fails (-64%), no extra LLM summary call. agentic saves 14% tokens but +20% wall-clock and 6 context-loss failures.
conclusions.one_line: agentic compaction causes stable -10pp Pass@1 decline on PyAether long-trajectory tasks; LLM summary loses precise context. Default: basic.
